statements.status_notes: temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x embed golang.org/x/net 0.55.0 via published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps x/net to 0.56.0; clearing this finding requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and x/net 0.56.0.

temporalio-admin-tools 1.28.x and 1.29.x embed golang.org/x/net 0.55.0 via published dhi/temporalio-server artifacts. debian-13 runtime packages are HSP-based, but these Go binaries still come from the server OCI artifact digests. The temporalio-server definition already bumps x/net to 0.56.0; clearing this finding requires republished server images and a digest track update. From 1.30 onward admin-tools builds these binaries from source with golang-1.26 HSP packages and x/net 0.56.0.

The BuildKit image includes runc, which brings in golang.org/x/net. The vulnerability is in golang.org/x/net/idna, but runc only imports golang.org/x/net/bpf from this module, so the affected idna package and ToASCII/ToUnicode functions are not present in the BuildKit image.
